title: BRISKET OF BEEF
instructions: Take one pound bag salt, two of saltpetre, a little sugar, and a few cloves. Rub this mixture well into the beef
every day for a week. Then it is fit for use. According to the size of the piece of beef, the mixture must be proportionally stronger.
